gloss_en: List all IfcSystem / distribution systems in the model and how many elements each has
prompt: list me all the systems in this ifc, with element count per system. mechanical/piping/duct
expected_behavior: List IfcSystem/IfcDistributionSystem, count assigned elements via IfcRelAssignsToGroup, report ungrouped elements.

gloss_en: Pipe fittings came out as proxies, find them
prompt: half my pipe fittings are IfcBuildingElementProxy after revit export?? find them and tell me which families
expected_behavior: Find proxies, group by ObjectType/family name, suggest IfcPipeFitting mapping.

gloss_en: Which duct segments have no flow rate property
prompt: which ducts dont have Pset flow / airflow value filled
expected_behavior: Iterate IfcDuctSegment, check psets for flow properties, list missing GUIDs and names.

prompt: total rebar weight per diameter, are the IfcReinforcingBar even in here
expected_behavior: Count IfcReinforcingBar, group by NominalDiameter, sum weight/length-based mass; report if none present.

prompt: exported to ifc and rebar is gone, is it in the file at all?
expected_behavior: Check for IfcReinforcingBar/IfcReinforcingMesh; if absent explain export settings (rebar in 3D views, visibility).

gloss_en: Does the file have analytical members
expected_behavior: Look for IfcStructuralAnalysisModel, IfcStructuralCurveMember, surface members; report count or absence.

prompt: what IFC classes did the beams and braces get, IfcBeam or IfcMember? show by type
expected_behavior: Group IfcBeam/IfcMember by type name and PredefinedType, flag braces typed as beams.

prompt: need duct vs beam clashes, with levels, for the coordination meeting
expected_behavior: Run clash between IfcDuctSegment and IfcBeam, report pairs with storey, export as BCF if supported.

prompt: set Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon Reference = 'CHW' on all pipes in system chilled water
expected_behavior: Select pipes assigned to the system, write property, confirm count modified, save new file.

prompt: compare v3 and v4 ifc, whats added/removed in mep, by guid
expected_behavior: Compare GlobalIds, report added/removed/changed MEP elements.

prompt: some columns went out as IfcBeam, fix to IfcColumn
expected_behavior: Identify vertical IfcBeam elements, change class to IfcColumn, report changes.

gloss_en: Why are MEP connections missing in IFC
prompt: how to get port connections in ifc export from revit mep? ports dont show
expected_behavior: Explain IfcDistributionPort and export option for MEP connectivity; check ports in the file.

gloss_en: Export analytical model to IFC for FEM
prompt: can i send analytical model from revit via ifc to robot/sap? how
expected_behavior: Explain IFC structural analysis view limits, recommended direct links, and what the file contains.

gloss_en: Pipe length per system and size
prompt: total pipe length by system and nominal diameter
expected_behavior: Sum Length of IfcPipeSegment by system and NominalDiameter, tabulate.

prompt: MEP elements not assigned to a storey? list
expected_behavior: Find MEP elements lacking IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure, list by class.
